seen_animation: A five-pointed outline star drawn in black open strokes, slightly left of centre. In frames 1-2 it is small and folded: the points are short and bunched, with the lower-left point stretched out as a long thin spike. From frame 3 to frame 8 the star grows and its points spread apart. The right and lower-right points lengthen the most. By frames 9-16 it is a full-size star that holds its place and changes only slightly: the top point gets a little taller and the right arm settles. The drawing stays in the same spot the whole time and does not rotate much.
seen_film: A white flower photographed on a black background, slightly left of centre, opens in time-lapse. In frames 1-2 it is a closed bud with one long sepal pointing down-left. In frames 3-6 the bud opens into a star shape with points down-left, down, up and right. In frames 7-9 more petals extend, especially to the right and upper right, and the flower reaches a six-pointed open bloom. In frames 9-16 it holds open with small changes to the petals and stamens. It stays in place throughout.
named_subject: A five-pointed star doodle performing the opening of a flower bud.
evidence: Judged from still frames only, not playback. e.png 1-5 hold the small folded star while f.png 1-5 hold the closed bud, with the long down-left spike in the same place as the film's down-left sepal. e.png 6-24 grow the star steadily while f.png 6-24 open the flower. The down point lengthens by e.png 8-10 as the film's lower petal appears at f.png 6-9, and the right point extends by e.png 17-20 as the film's right petal extends at f.png 17-20. e.png 25-50 hold the full star at near-constant size and position, as f.png 25-50 hold the open bloom. g.png shows the centre staying in one small cluster with concentric growth and no reversals or gaps. Consecutive frames in e.png change by small amounts. Nothing doubles or pops, and the size grows monotonically. The film's own abrupt changes (blurred f.png 2, bud bursting open at f.png 6) are smoothed in the animation rather than copied, which is acceptable.
primary_gap: The film's flower opens to six spread petals with the upper-right petal appearing late (f.png 19-25), but the star keeps five points, so the late upper-right opening in the film has nothing that corresponds to it in the animation.
closes_when: Across e.png 19-25 the star's right arm (or the stroke break on it) visibly swings upward or splits toward the upper right, at the same time as the film's upper-right petal unfolds. The star must keep five points drawn in the doodle's stroke habits.
protect: The fixed position and steady concentric growth seen in g.png. The hold of the small folded state in e.png 1-5, matching the bud hold. The down-left spike matching the film's sepal. The doodle's open-stroke construction from c.png, including the stroke breaks on the right arm and lower-right point and the hooked tail at the bottom. The calm hold in e.png 25-50.
identity_gap: Once open, the star matches c.png in its stroke breaks and hooked lower stroke, but in e.png 1-4 the folded star has a long thin spike and cramped points, which makes it look less like the doodle than the open frames do.
